VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.label: myrmidon
VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.description: Ant-derived creatures bred into diverse forms of livestock, retaining aspects of their ancestral biology beneath their oversized forms.

VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.label: beetle
VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.description: Hardy arthropods prized for their resilience and diverse adaptations, selectively bred into livestock suited to a variety of environments and purposes.

VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.label: behemoth
VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.description: Large arthropods adapted to extreme low temperatures.

VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.label: lucifer bugs
VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.description: Small insectoids, genetically modified to produce small batches of Luciferium extract every few days.

VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.label: silkies
VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.description: Large flightless birds, genetically modified to produce both edible eggs and a valuable silk-like textile.

VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.label: night mule
VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeFamilyDe.description: A hardy pack beasts, used for transporting loads or doing other heavy work, they originate from a RimWorld orbiting a very faint star and thus they have adapted to environments with low sunlight.
